question: What did Piccard see through his porthole on the trench floor in 1960?
answer: Piccard saw white mud on the floor of the Mariana Trench, in crystal-clear water. With the lights on, the water was so limpid he could see out through the plexiglass porthole. It was 3.5 °C outside.
move: The deepest floor on Earth: white mud under crystal-clear water.
